generate_hawkes_sequence: generate a synthetic Hawkes process event sequence using Ogata thinning with given alpha, mu, and omega parameters
run_EM_learning: run the MAP EM algorithm to learn alpha and mu parameters from an observed event sequence
check_process_stability: check the stability of the Hawkes process by verifying the maximum eigenvalue of alpha is less than one
get_instantaneous_rate: get the instantaneous event rate at a specific time point for a given dimension in the Hawkes process
plot_event_rates: plot the time-varying intensity rates and event occurrences for each dimension of the Hawkes process
